ModMetaData.name: Yayo's Combat 3 - Auto Reload Regression Fix
ModMetaData.author: FlowMorph
ModMetaData.description:
恢复 Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon 1.6.10 中存在、在 1.6.11 被删除的 UsedOnce 自动换弹触发。
修复敌对 Pawn 背包中有弹药却不换弹，以及开启 refillMechAmmo 时非 Humanlike Pawn 打空后无法自动补弹的问题。补丁只恢复 Addon 原有调用，不增加额外 AI 或 ThinkTree 逻辑。
Restores the UsedOnce auto-reload trigger present in Yayo's Combat 3 - Addon 1.6.10 and removed in 1.6.11.
Fixes hostile pawns failing to reload from inventory and non-Humanlike pawns failing to receive the existing refillMechAmmo behavior after emptying a weapon. This patch only restores the Addon's original call path; it adds no new AI or ThinkTree logic.
